user_story: As a staff member, I want deleting a confirmed booking to return an error so that active reservations are protected.

positive.title: Verify that attempting to delete a confirmed booking returns an error.
steps: Locate a confirmed booking in the system.
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking.
positive.expected_result: Error message is displayed stating that active reservations cannot be deleted.

negative.title: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot delete a confirmed booking.
steps: Attempt to delete a confirmed booking.
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed stating insufficient permissions to delete booking.

edge.title: Verify behavior when trying to delete a booking with no active reservations.
steps: Create a booking and change its status to canceled.
Attempt to delete the canceled booking.
edge.expected_result: The booking is deleted successfully without any error.
